title: A 4.89223N full-B2 lower bound from certified cubic-tree branch probabilities

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. Let L(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee.leading. Let R(n) be the sum of the monomials in guarantee.remainder.terms, each coefficient times n^exponent*(log2 n)^log_exponent*(log2 log2 n)^loglog_exponent; an empty sum is zero. There exists N such that C_B2(f_n)>=L(n)-R(n) for every integer n>=N. All remainder coefficients are the exact declared constants. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"The total norm-one language defined in family.md. Reject lengths below 16 and invalid irreducibility headers. In the field E defined by the headers at actual length N, accept precisely when the payload z raised to the sum of 2^(mj) over 0<=j<t equals one. Ignore the tail. The verifier uses an empty witness.","guarantee":{"kind":"eventual_lower_bound","leading":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"100000","numerator":"489223"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"remainder":{"kind":"explicit","terms":[]}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"100000","numerator":"489223"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"For every sufficiently large integer input length N, every single-output full-B2 circuit computing this fixed language has at least (489223/100000)N gates, with unrestricted sharing and repeated pins.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v2"}
